name: Wana | 100mg Gummies | Lime Margarita 1:1:1
description: With a mouth-watering burst of lime (and a hint of salt), these first-of-their kind fast-acting gummies contain 10mg each of CBD, THC, and CBG – a rare cannabinoid that elevates the stress-relieving neurotransmitter GABA. The result is a uniquely social and creative high, perfect for hangover-free fun.
